# InputAnswerScope

`schemas/api/scope/input-answer.json`

The scope of input.answer (docs/design/m0/04 "Owed inputs" [PR5-1]): the owed input, the revision the answer binds, and the typed answer. The approval's answers list is derived from it. Only an operator or the owed input's owner answers (failed/action_not_granted). An owed input of kind receipt is refused as an invalid scope: only an applicable receipt satisfies it. Otherwise it is refused unless unanswered and at exactly that revision (failed/stale_expected_state).

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `owed_input` | yes | [OwedInputID](common-defs.md#owedinputid) |  |
| `owed_revision` | yes | integer (minimum `0`, maximum `9007199254740991`) |  |
| `answer` | yes | object (open payload) | The answer, typed by the owed input's kind. |

No other fields are allowed.
